mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'kb_id', c.kb_id, 'statement_id', c.statement_id, 'expected_property_id', c.expected_property_id, 'expected_direction', c.expected_direction, 'created_by', c.created_by, 'created_at', c.created_at, 'origin', c.origin, 'last_checked_at', c.last_checked_at, 'last_result', c.last_result, 'subject_id', f.subject_id, 'subject_label', s.canonical_name, 'phrase', f.phrase, 'object_id', f.object_id, 'object_label', o.canonical_name, 'object_value', f.object_value, 'expected_property_label', expected.label, 'expected_property_key', expected.key, 'actual_property_label', actual.label, 'actual_property_key', actual.key, 'created_by_label', u.nick_name) AS view FROM ontology_regression_cases c JOIN facts f ON f.kb_id=c.kb_id AND f.id=c.statement_id JOIN entities s ON s.kb_id=f.kb_id AND s.id=f.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.kb_id=f.kb_id AND o.id=f.object_id JOIN relation_types expected ON expected.kb_id=c.kb_id AND expected.id=c.expected_property_id LEFT JOIN relation_types actual ON actual.kb_id=c.kb_id AND actual.id=(c.last_result->>'actual_property_id')::uuid LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid=c.created_by WHERE c.kb_id=#{kbId} AND f.layer='open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id
SELECT * FROM ontology_regression_cases WHERE kb_id=#{kbId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT object_id IS NULL FROM facts WHERE kb_id=#{kbId} AND id=#{statementId} AND layer='open' AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND nullif(btrim(phrase),'') IS NOT NULL FOR SHARE
SELECT kind FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id=#{kbId} AND id=#{propertyId} FOR SHARE

INSERT INTO ontology_regression_cases (id,kb_id,statement_id,expected_property_id,expected_direction,created_by,origin) VALUES(#{id},#{kbId},#{statementId},#{expectedPropertyId},#{expectedDirection},#{createdBy},#{origin}) ON CONFLICT(kb_id,statement_id,expected_property_id,expected_direction) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT id FROM ontology_regression_cases WHERE kb_id=#{kbId} AND statement_id=#{statementId} AND expected_property_id=#{expectedPropertyId} AND expected_direction=#{expectedDirection}
mapper.update: UPDATE ontology_regression_cases c SET last_checked_at=b.decided_at, last_result=jsonb_build_object('passed',coalesce((b.decided_by='person' AND b.status='bound') OR (b.status='bound' AND b.relation_type_id=c.expected_property_id AND b.direction=c.expected_direction),false), 'human_bound',b.decided_by='person' AND b.status='bound','actual_property_id',b.relation_type_id, 'actual_direction',b.direction,'status',b.status,'decided_at',b.decided_at) FROM facts f JOIN entities s ON s.id=f.subject_id AND s.kb_id=f.kb_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id=f.object_id AND o.kb_id=f.kb_id JOIN phrase_bindings b ON b.kb_id=f.kb_id AND b.phrase=lower(btrim(regexp_replace(f.phrase,'\s+',' ','g'))) AND b.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.type_id AND b.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.type_id AND b.object_is_value=(f.object_id IS NULL) WHERE c.kb_id=#{kbId} AND c.statement_id=f.id AND f.kb_id=c.kb_id AND f.layer='open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND c.id=#{id} AND c.last_checked_at IS NULL

UPDATE ontology_regression_cases c SET last_checked_at=now(), last_result=jsonb_build_object('passed',coalesce((b.decided_by='person' AND b.status='bound') OR (b.status='bound' AND b.relation_type_id=c.expected_property_id AND b.direction=c.expected_direction),false), 'human_bound',b.decided_by='person' AND b.status='bound','actual_property_id',b.relation_type_id, 'actual_direction',b.direction,'status',b.status,'decided_at',b.decided_at) FROM facts f JOIN entities s ON s.id=f.subject_id AND s.kb_id=f.kb_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id=f.object_id AND o.kb_id=f.kb_id JOIN phrase_bindings b ON b.kb_id=f.kb_id AND b.phrase=lower(btrim(regexp_replace(f.phrase,'\s+',' ','g'))) AND b.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.type_id AND b.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.type_id AND b.object_is_value=(f.object_id IS NULL) WHERE c.kb_id=#{kbId} AND c.statement_id=f.id AND f.kb_id=c.kb_id AND f.layer='open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND b.phrase=#{phrase} AND b.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{subjectTypeId} AND b.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{objectTypeId} AND b.object_is_value=#{objectIsValue}

UPDATE ontology_regression_cases c SET last_checked_at=now(), last_result=jsonb_build_object('passed',coalesce((b.decided_by='person' AND b.status='bound') OR (b.status='bound' AND b.relation_type_id=c.expected_property_id AND b.direction=c.expected_direction),false), 'human_bound',b.decided_by='person' AND b.status='bound','actual_property_id',b.relation_type_id, 'actual_direction',b.direction,'status',b.status,'decided_at',b.decided_at) FROM facts f JOIN entities s ON s.id=f.subject_id AND s.kb_id=f.kb_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id=f.object_id AND o.kb_id=f.kb_id JOIN phrase_bindings b ON b.kb_id=f.kb_id AND b.phrase=lower(btrim(regexp_replace(f.phrase,'\s+',' ','g'))) AND b.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.type_id AND b.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.type_id AND b.object_is_value=(f.object_id IS NULL) WHERE c.kb_id=#{kbId} AND c.statement_id=f.id AND f.kb_id=c.kb_id AND f.layer='open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND b.decided_by='person'
